  const selector =
    'a[href*="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#"], .__cf_email__[data-cfemail]';
  const attributeParser = document.createElement('div');
  function decode(encoded) {
    if (!/^(?:[\da-f]{2}){2,}$/i.test(encoded)) return null;
    const key = parseInt(encoded.slice(0, 2), 16);
    const bytes = encoded
      .slice(2)
      .match(/../g)

    const value = new window.TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(bytes));

    attributeParser.innerHTML = `<a href="${value.replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/</g, '<')}"></a>`;

  }

    const elements = [...root.querySelectorAll(selector)];
    if (root.matches?.(selector)) elements.unshift(root);
    for (const element of elements) {
      const href = element.getAttribute('href');

    for (const record of records) {

  if (window.emailDecodeObserver) return;

  const prefix = '/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#';
  const selector =
    'a[href*="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#"], .__cf_email__[data-cfemail]';
  const attributeParser = document.createElement('div');
  function decode(encoded) {
    if (!/^(?:[\da-f]{2}){2,}$/i.test(encoded)) return null;
    const key = parseInt(encoded.slice(0, 2), 16);
    const bytes = encoded
      .slice(2)
      .match(/../g)
      .map((byte) => parseInt(byte, 16) ^ key);
    const value = new window.TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(bytes));
    // Cloudflare encodes HTML attribute source, including character references.
    attributeParser.innerHTML = `<a href="${value.replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/</g, '<')}"></a>`;
    return attributeParser.firstChild.getAttribute('href');
  }

  function restore(root) {
    const elements = [...root.querySelectorAll(selector)];
    if (root.matches?.(selector)) elements.unshift(root);
    for (const element of elements) {
      const href = element.getAttribute('href');
      if (href?.includes(prefix)) {
        const value = decode(href.slice(href.indexOf(prefix) + prefix.length));
        if (value !== null) element.setAttribute('href', `mailto:${value}`);
      }
      if (element.matches('.__cf_email__[data-cfemail]')) {
        const value = decode(element.getAttribute('data-cfemail'));
        if (value !== null) element.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(value));
      }
    }
  }

  restore(document);
  window.emailDecodeObserver = new window.MutationObserver((records) => {
    for (const record of records) {
      for (const node of record.addedNodes) {
        if (node.nodeType === 1) restore(node);
      }
    }
  });
  window.emailDecodeObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true,
  });
})();
